children: Overview
UK homebuilder reported FY26 revenue up 6.6% yr/yr, with 17,667 homes completed
Adjusted profit before tax fell 7.1% yr/yr amid margin pressure and market challenges
Company completed Redrow integration, delivered £73 mln cost synergies, and announced £400 mln capital return for FY27
Outlook
Company expects FY27 total home completions of 17,500-17,900, down from prior 17,700-18,200 guidance
Company anticipates c. 40% of FY27 completions will be delivered in first half
Barratt Redrow says higher mortgage rates and affordability pressures to continue impacting customer confidence
Result Drivers
COST SYNERGIES - Redrow integration delivered £73 mln cost synergies in FY26, with £100 mln target confirmed
SALES INCENTIVES - Co used sales incentives to maintain home completion volumes amid subdued consumer sentiment and affordability challenges
